title: NDP (No Dirt Patches)
description: a datapack removing those annoying dirt patches you find everywhere underground
body:
# title card
Are you tired of all of those stupid dirt patches when you're mining? Are you willing to install this datapack? Well then you're in luck! This datapack removes then dirt patches!

what this pack does is it removes the dirt patches by setting their size to 0, so the game spawns them but they dont exist! yay!

![the title...](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dda3d50b8f8a09849c85005ada4d7848f2a4c06e.png)

credit to blockbench and title maker for the beautiful image above


I'm going through all my dumb low effort projects and changing their descriptions but this one is already kinda peak
